newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ dollar seen lower after quiet day.
newsitem.headline: NZ dollar seen lower after quiet day.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar closed off its highs for the day on Monday in very narrow trading, dealers said.
"It has been a very, very quiet day today," one chief dealer said.
The kiwi traded in a range between US$0.7141 and 0.7153 and hovered around 0.7145 for most of the day.
On the Trade Weighted Index it closed at 67.03, off one basis point.
"We just had a slight blip lower than 0.7140 as the Aussie came off 20 points from its high on the day," the dealer said.
"There has been no interest out of Tokyo -- the first time in a wee while -- and I think we might look a little lower with an overnight range of 0.7125-55," he said.
